BS40-CP07.name: The DefenseEmperor Gunned Bison
BS40-CP07.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this card from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve, and during this turn, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
By discarding one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.
